versionStatus: PHASE_9D_ALBUM_CAPTURE_ROUND — 1.39.0 delivers the honest carry 'the album-draft CAPTURING side (the admin surface gathering a media group from real Telegram updates)' (schema 6 UNCHANGED — ZERO migration, ZERO DDL): (1) the PURE capture module ac1 (NEW src/domain/media/album-capture.ts): the /album_capture argument grammar (start <storyId> / status (no args) / finish / cancel — the reserved words, the whole-token story id, a grammar failure BEFORE any query could exist), the TOTAL state reader (the ac1 version pin; a corrupt/foreign state_json is INVALID, never repaired), the append rules (photo/video only, the 2..10 media-group bound, the one-caption rule — the FIRST caption-carrying member wins, a duplicate file_id refuses typed), and the capture-only canonical namespace album-capture:<sessionId>/<ordinal> (deterministic, bounded, a namespace a REAL source URL can never collide with); (2) the FENCED capture store (NEW src/adapters/db/album-capture-store.ts) over the GENERIC admin_sessions table (flow 'album_capture', step 'active', the 15-minute TTL): the start (any previous active session of the SAME actor is marked 'replaced' — at most ONE active capture per actor), the fenced read-modify-write append (the rowcount is the authority — an expired/completed/replaced session loses honestly), the cancel, and the FENCED finish: the 2..10 bound checked BEFORE any write (an under-filled session is refused honestly and STAYS active), then ONE executor.batch commits the N media_assets candidate rows AND the session completion together (a partial capture never exists) — the rows are the OD-010 honest evidence (status 'candidate', rights_status 'unknown', the live telegram_file_id, the capture-only canonical identity), plus ONE audit event (album_captured, actor 'admin', the DETERMINISTIC id album-capture:<sessionId>, metadata = storyId/itemCount/captureVersion only); (3) the SURFACES: the INDEPENDENT fail-closed ADMIN_ALBUM_CAPTURE_ENABLED (default 'false', invalid-present = disabled, shipped 'false' everywhere: wrangler/.env.example/.dev.vars.example/env.ts) gates the /album_capture command and the media-group member capture ONLY — while OFF the command is the unknown-command noop and media-group members keep the EXACT legacy behavior (the admin-post capture's explicit album-member rejection, or the not_a_command noop); the router emits the typed album_capture_command / album_capture_media actions (private chat only; edited messages noop; a SINGLE non-album photo is NEVER captured here — the R1.21 path owns it); the service refuses honestly when no session is active (never a silent swallow); RBAC draft.create (the capture creates draft-adjacent evidence); (4) THE OD-010 BOUNDARY PROVEN END-TO-END: after a successful finish, the REAL producer over the REAL captured rows refuses TYPED at the planner gate (plan_derivation_failed / candidate_malformed — the capture-only namespace is not a source-media URL; an admin-captured album is not a source-media album; the admin-capture production route is PART of the OD-010 owner decision, no route exists yet — deliberately) and the ledger binding could never resolve a candidate+unknown row anyway; the machine invents NO permission and NOTHING on this surface can send (asserted on the SQL texts + the fake transport). RED-first held: tests/unit/album-capture.test.ts (15) + tests/integration/admin-album-capture.test.ts (16 REAL-D1, registered in test:db) written FIRST with real RED (cannot-resolve-module on the new modules) then GREEN; the in-round honest finding: the OD-010 e2e test originally expected the ledger-binding refusal but the planner refuses one layer EARLIER (candidate_malformed) — the test pins the OBSERVED honest behavior and the design doc records the two-layer boundary. GATES: npm run check exit 0 and npm run test:db exit 0 on the delivery tree — exact counts in PROJECT_STATUS.md. HONEST CARRY: the zod v4 TRACKED migration and the rights-EVIDENCE model (OD-010: scope/expiry/attribution/write surface incl. the admin-capture production route) stay carried; LIVE surfaces BLOCKED_LIVE (Posidon only).
